remarks: Welcome to 172 Zephyr Run, a beautifully maintained detached 3-bedroom home in the desirable Tustin Field community! Tucked away in a private rear location, this light-filled residence offers a comfortable, functional layout with laminate wood and tile flooring, a cozy fireplace, and a spacious kitchen with a walk-in pantry. Upstairs, the primary suite features a soaking tub, separate shower, and walk-in closet with custom organizers. One of the home's most desirable features is its rare, full-length driveway with parking for two additional vehicles, complementing the attached two-car garage with epoxy flooring. A beautifully landscaped backyard with a brick-paved patio and ambient lighting
